story.title: The name came later
story.eyebrow: Before the Maison, there was the source
story.paragraph1: Our foundations formed years earlier, at the water’s edge, alongside producers whose understanding of sturgeon husbandry runs decades deep.
story.paragraph2: That proximity taught us to see caviar as something decided long before the tin: in the water that raises the fish, the feed it is given, the years it is allowed, and the moment it is finally taken. Each decision was refined long before the caviar is eventually served.
story.paragraph3: Maison Rocheval exists to hold that knowledge together. A deep respect for everything that happens before the harvest, and a clear conviction about what earns the right to carry the name.
story.imageAlt: Founder of Maison Rocheval standing in front of a dining table and classical painting

venues.title: At the table
venues.intro: In time, that knowledge found its way to the tables of chefs and private hosts. Each service sharpened the same idea a little further: what the next generation of caviar could be.

sushiSakuta.name: Sushi Sakuta | Chef Yoshio Sakuta

selection.title: Time is part of the harvest
selection.description: Selection begins upstream. How the sturgeon was raised, what it was fed, and the moment chosen for harvest.
selection.imageAlt: Producer selecting a sturgeon at harvest
selection.caption: The caviar is read as a whole
selection.detail1: Colour, grain, texture, firmness and moisture are considered alongside salinity, aroma, maturation and the integrity of each pearl.
selection.detail2: On the palate, flavour unfolds in layers. What appears first matters, but so does what remains: depth, length and the character of the finish.

ritual.title: THE RITUAL

sourceToRitual.title: From source to ritual
sourceToRitual.intro: Caviar has always carried ceremony: the chilled tin, the turn of the key, mother-of-pearl against the grain, the first spoonful taken before anyone speaks.
sourceToRitual.description: Maison Rocheval preserves that ceremony with restraint. Not as a performance, but because how something is served changes how it is remembered, and the finest tables understand this instinctively, whether found in a celebrated dining room or set for two at home.
sourceToRitual.preparationAlt: Chef preparing a tin of caviar
sourceToRitual.serviceAlt: Caviar served in a glass dish

origin.title: It begins with the sturgeon
origin.description: Long before a harvest is selected, its character is being formed. Species, water, diet, maturity and time each leave their mark on the caviar that follows.

collection.title: Understanding our collection
collection.description: As a living product, it’s grain, texture and flavor is read fresh with every selection rather than reduced to a number. A number cannot hold what changes by the week.
collection.tinAlt: An open tin of Maison Rocheval caviar resting on its lid
collection.selectorLabel: Choose a caviar from the collection

amour.name: Amour
amour.description: Amour opens with cream, then butter, followed by a soft lactic warmth that lingers rather than lifts. Salinity is almost an afterthought, allowing the caviar to read closer to cultured cheese than to the sea.
amour.descriptionSecondary: It is the gentlest caviar in the collection, and often the most persuasive.
amour.atTable: Warm blini, crème fraîche, soft egg, potato. Amour rewards richness and simplicity, or anything with enough fat to meet it halfway. Acid and smoke should be used with restraint to allow its quiet character a chance to speak.
amour.tinAlt: Tin of Armour caviar, open beside its lid
amour.dishAlt: Blini topped with Armour caviar, served on a copper plate

lexpression.name: L’Expression
lexpression.description: L’Expression is drawn from the same two lines that anchor this collection: the nuttiness of Kaluga, the cream of Amour. Neither comes through. What emerges instead is marine and deeply savoury: kelp, nori, a rounded salinity that deepens into umami and carries through the finish.
lexpression.descriptionSecondary: It is made from the house’s own two poles, and tastes like neither. That is precisely why L’Expression sits at the heart of the Maison.
lexpression.atTable: Dashi, seasoned rice, cured fish, brown butter, and anything built on umami. L’Expression has the depth to enter a dish rather than sit above it, making it the caviar to build around, not simply to finish with.
lexpression.tinAlt: Tin of L’Expression caviar, open beside its lid
lexpression.dishAlt: Cured fish in a dashi broth finished with L’Expression caviar

harmonie.name: Harmonie
harmonie.description: Harmonie opens bright, with an unusual fruit-led sweetness recalling the delicacy of Kyoho grapes, carried by soft salinity and a clean, savoury finish. With time in the tin, the fruit settles into something deeper and smokier. Both are Harmonie. They simply belong to different weeks.
harmonie.descriptionSecondary: It is the caviar least like the others in the collection. Because those different weeks offer genuinely different qualities, it is perhaps the most adaptable of the five.
harmonie.atTable: Shellfish, butter sauces, and anything that moves between sweet and savoury. Its character develops with age, so it rewards a taste before it reaches the plate.
harmonie.tinAlt: Tin of Harmonie caviar, open beside its lid
harmonie.dishAlt: Plated fish and vegetables finished with Harmonie caviar

oscietra.name: Oscietra
oscietra.description: Precise and unmistakably Oscietra. Iodine first, followed by walnut and a fine, lifted minerality. The grain holds its structure on the tongue before releasing slowly into a finish that rewards nothing more than attention.
oscietra.descriptionSecondary: This is the caviar against which most others are still measured: the profile that has defined Oscietra for as long as caviar has been written about.
oscietra.atTable: Chilled, with mother-of-pearl. The traditional service, and still the correct one. Oysters, raw fish, cold shellfish, or Oscietra entirely on its own. It asks to be tasted, not dressed.
oscietra.tinAlt: Tin of Oscietra caviar, open beside its lid
oscietra.dishAlt: Plated fish and vegetables finished with Oscietra caviar

kaluga.name: Kaluga
kaluga.description: The largest grain in the house, and the most patient on the palate. What arrives first is presence: butter, cream, and a richness that announces itself before any single note does. Roasted hazelnut follows, then a restrained salinity that draws everything into a finish that outlasts the rest of the range.
kaluga.descriptionSecondary: Its scale is matched by its restraint. Richness never becomes weight, and its character continues to reveal itself well beyond the first spoon.
kaluga.atTable: Kaluga asks for very little. Chilled, with mother-of-pearl, and nothing else competing for attention. Let the grain, texture and length do the work.
kaluga.tinAlt: Tin of Kaluga caviar, open beside its lid
kaluga.dishAlt: Plated fish and vegetables finished with Kaluga caviar

items.question: What is caviar?
items.answer: Salt-cured roe from sturgeon (family Acipenseridae). Roe from other fish — salmon, trout — isn’t caviar.

items.question: What’s the difference between caviar and fish roe?
items.answer: Roe can come from any fish; caviar comes only from sturgeon.

items.question: Which caviars does Maison Rocheval offer?
items.answer:
Five, listed from the most delicate to the fullest:

  • Amour (Acipenser schrenckii): cream and butter, barely saline; the gentlest in the collection. With warm blini, crème fraîche, soft egg.
  • L'Expression (Huso dauricus × A. schrenckii): the house signature; marine and savoury, kelp and nori deepening into umami. With dashi, seasoned rice, cured fish.
  • Harmonie (A. gueldenstaedtii × A. baerii): bright, fruit-led sweetness that turns smokier with age. With shellfish and butter sauces.
  • Oscietra (A. gueldenstaedtii): the classical benchmark; iodine, walnut and fine minerality. Chilled, with mother-of-pearl, or on its own.
  • Kaluga (Huso dauricus): the largest grain; butter, cream, roasted hazelnut and a long finish. Chilled, with mother-of-pearl.

items.question: How do you grade your caviar?
items.answer: We don’t use numbered grades. Each harvest is judged fresh and as a whole — colour, grain, texture, salinity, aroma and finish.

items.question: What does “malossol” mean?
items.answer: Russian for “little salt.” Our caviar is cured malossol — minimal salt, so the flavour of the roe leads.

items.question: How should I store it before opening?
items.answer: Keep the unopened tin in the coldest part of the fridge (−2 to +3°C). Don’t freeze. It keeps up to 3 months — always check the best-before date.

items.question: How long does it last once opened?
items.answer: Best within 24 hours. Reseal, press out the air, and keep it cold.

items.question: Can I freeze caviar?
items.answer: No — freezing ruptures the grains and ruins the texture and flavour.

items.question: Why a mother-of-pearl spoon, not metal?
items.answer: Metal reacts with caviar and adds a metallic taste. Use mother-of-pearl, bone or horn.

items.question: How is it served?
items.answer: Straight from the chilled tin, or on blini with crème fraîche. Serve cold, resting the tin on ice.

items.question: What drinks pair with caviar?
items.answer: Champagne or dry sparkling wine, chilled vodka, or a crisp dry white such as Chablis.

items.question: Is caviar good for you?
items.answer: It’s rich in protein, vitamin B12 and omega-3, and high in sodium — so it’s served in small portions.

items.question: Is your caviar sustainable?
items.answer: Yes — farmed rather than wild, and CITES-certified.

items.question: Does it contain any additives?
items.answer: None. No artificial colouring and no preservatives.

privacyPolicy.intro1: This Privacy Policy explains how Maison Rocheval Pte. Ltd. (“Maison Rocheval,” “we,” “us,” or “our”) collects, uses, discloses, and protects your personal information when you visit maison-rocheval.com (the “Site”), purchase our products, or otherwise interact with us.
privacyPolicy.intro2: This policy is designed to meet the requirements of the EU/UK General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), the California Consumer Privacy Act as amended by the CPRA and other U.S. state privacy laws, and Singapore’s Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (PDPA). Where a specific regime grants you additional rights, the relevant section below applies to you.

sections.title: 1. Who we are
sections.body:
The controller responsible for your personal data is:

  • Legal entity: Maison Rocheval Pte. Ltd.
  • Brand: Maison Rocheval

You can contact us, including our Data Protection Officer, about any privacy matter through the contact form on our website: maison-rocheval.com/contact.

sections.title: 2. Information we collect
sections.body:
Information you give us

  • Identity and contact details: name, billing and shipping address, email, phone number.
  • Order and transaction data: products purchased, order history, delivery preferences.
  • Payment information: processed by our payment providers; we do not store full card numbers.
  • Account credentials, if you create an account.
  • Communications: messages you send us via the contact form, email, or customer service.
  • Marketing preferences and any information you provide when subscribing.

Information collected automatically

  • Device and usage data: IP address, browser type, operating system, referring pages, pages viewed, timestamps.
  • Cookies and similar technologies (see Section 7).

Information from third parties

  • Payment processors, fraud-prevention services, shipping and logistics partners, and analytics providers.

We do not intentionally collect special categories of data (e.g., health, religion, biometrics). Please do not submit such data to us.

sections.title: 3. How we use your information
sections.body:
We use your personal data to:

  • Process and fulfil orders, arrange shipping, and handle returns.
  • Take payment and prevent fraud.
  • Provide customer support and respond to enquiries.
  • Manage your account.
  • Send transactional communications (order confirmations, delivery updates).
  • Send marketing communications where you have consented or where otherwise permitted.
  • Operate, secure, and improve the Site.
  • Comply with legal, tax, accounting, and regulatory obligations.

sections.title: 4. Legal bases for processing (EU/EEA and UK users)
sections.body:
We rely on the following legal bases under the GDPR:

PurposeLegal basis
Fulfilling your order, account managementPerformance of a contract (Art. 6(1)(b))
Payment, fraud prevention, securityLegitimate interests (Art. 6(1)(f))
Tax, accounting, regulatory record-keepingLegal obligation (Art. 6(1)(c))
Marketing emails, non-essential cookiesConsent (Art. 6(1)(a))
Product improvement, analyticsLegitimate interests / consent

Where we rely on legitimate interests, we have balanced those interests against your rights. You may object at any time (see Section 9).

sections.title: 5. How we share your information
sections.body:
We share personal data with:

  • Service providers / processors: payment processors, shipping and cold-chain logistics partners, website hosting and infrastructure (Vercel Inc.), analytics providers (Google LLC for Google Analytics; Vercel Inc. for Vercel Analytics), email, and customer-service tools.
  • Professional advisers: lawyers, accountants, auditors.
  • Authorities: where required by law, regulation, or legal process.
  • Business transfers: in connection with a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets.

We require processors to protect your data and to use it only on our instructions. We do not sell your personal information for money, and we do not share it for cross-context behavioral advertising.

sections.title: 6. International data transfers
sections.body:
We operate across Singapore, the EU/France, the United States (including California), and Hong Kong, so your data may be transferred and stored outside your home country.

For transfers of EU/EEA or UK data to countries without an adequacy decision, we rely on appropriate safeguards, such as the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) and, where relevant, the UK Addendum. For transfers of Singapore data, we take reasonable steps to ensure a comparable standard of protection as required under the PDPA. A copy of the relevant safeguards is available on request via our contact form.

sections.title: 7. Cookies and similar technologies
sections.body:
We use cookies and similar technologies to operate the Site, remember your preferences, and analyse traffic.

  • Strictly necessary cookies — required for the Site to function.
  • Analytics cookies — help us understand how visitors use the Site. We use:
    • Google Analytics (provided by Google LLC / Google Ireland Limited), which uses cookies and similar identifiers to measure traffic and usage. Google processes this data on our behalf; data may be transferred to the United States. See Google's Privacy Policy and how Google uses information from sites that use its services. You can opt out via the Google Analytics Opt-out Browser Add-on.
    • Vercel Analytics / Vercel Speed Insights (provided by Vercel Inc.), which measure Site traffic and performance. Vercel's Web Analytics is designed to operate without cookies and without tracking individuals across sites. See Vercel's Privacy Policy.

Where required (EU/EEA/UK), non-essential cookies — including Google Analytics — are set only after you consent via our cookie banner. You can also control cookies through your browser settings and by enabling Global Privacy Control (GPC) signals in your browser.

sections.title: 8. Data retention
sections.body:
We keep personal data only as long as necessary for the purposes described, including to satisfy legal, tax, and reporting requirements. As a general rule:

  • Order and transaction records: retained for 5 years to meet tax and accounting obligations.
  • Account data: retained while your account is active, then deleted or anonymised.
  • Marketing data: retained until you unsubscribe or withdraw consent.

When data is no longer needed, we securely delete or anonymise it.

sections.title: 9. Your rights (EU/EEA and UK — GDPR)
sections.body:
If you are in the EU/EEA or UK, you have the right to:

  • Access the personal data we hold about you.
  • Rectify inaccurate or incomplete data.
  • Erase your data (“right to be forgotten”).
  • Restrict processing in certain circumstances.
  • Data portability — receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format.
  • Object to processing based on legitimate interests, and to direct marketing at any time.
  • Withdraw consent at any time, without affecting prior lawful processing.
  • Lodge a complaint with your local supervisory authority (in France, the CNIL; in the UK, the ICO).

To exercise any right, contact us via our contact form. We will respond within one month, as required by the GDPR.

sections.title: 10. Your rights (United States — California and other states)
sections.body:
This section applies to U.S. residents, including residents of California, Virginia, Colorado, Connecticut, Utah, and other states with comprehensive privacy laws.

Categories of personal information we collect include identifiers (name, email, address), commercial information (purchase history), internet activity (browsing on the Site), approximate geolocation (from IP), and payment information. We collect these for the business purposes described in Section 3.

Depending on your state, you have the right to:

  • Know / access the personal information we have collected about you.
  • Delete personal information, subject to exceptions.
  • Correct inaccurate personal information.
  • Opt out of the “sale” or “sharing” of personal information and of targeted advertising.
  • Limit the use of sensitive personal information, where applicable.
  • Non-discrimination for exercising your rights.

We do not sell personal information for money and do not share it for cross-context behavioral advertising. We honor Global Privacy Control (GPC) signals. To exercise any of these rights, contact us via our contact form. We will verify your identity before responding, and you may use an authorized agent.

sections.title: 11. Your rights (Singapore — PDPA)
sections.body:
Under the PDPA you may:

  • Request access to your personal data and information about how it has been used or disclosed.
  • Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data.
  • Withdraw consent to our collection, use, or disclosure of your personal data, on reasonable notice. Withdrawal may affect our ability to provide products or services to you.

We will respond to access and correction requests within the timeframes required under the PDPA. Our Data Protection Officer is responsible for ensuring our compliance and can be reached via our contact form.

sections.title: 12. Data security
sections.body: We implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect personal data against unauthorised access, loss, misuse, or alteration — including encryption in transit, access controls, and use of reputable processors. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security. We will notify you and the relevant authorities of a data breach where required by law.

sections.title: 13. Children's privacy
sections.body: The Site is not directed to children, and we do not knowingly collect personal data from children under 16. If you believe a child has provided us with personal data, contact us and we will delete it.

sections.title: 14. Third-party links
sections.body: The Site may contain links to third-party websites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of those sites, and we encourage you to review their policies.

sections.title: 15. Changes to this policy
sections.body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will post the updated version with a revised “Last updated” date and, where required, notify you of material changes.

sections.title: 16. Contact us
sections.body: For any questions, requests, or complaints regarding this policy or your personal data, please reach us through the contact form on our website: maison-rocheval.com/contact.

items.question: Which caviar should I choose?
items.answer: Begin with the texture and finish you enjoy; each collection page explains the defining profile.

items.question: Why does sturgeon maturity matter?
items.answer: Maturity shapes the size, integrity and aromatic depth of the grain.

items.question: How is caviar salted?
items.answer: Maison Rocheval uses a restrained salting process to preserve the harvest’s natural expression.

items.question: Are the sturgeon responsibly raised?
items.answer: We select producers whose husbandry, water and harvesting standards meet those of the Maison.

items.question: How long does caviar keep after opening?
items.answer: Enjoy an opened tin promptly and keep it refrigerated between 0°C and 4°C.
